title: Operation Blackout
summary: Correlate five evidence sources to reconstruct a complete APT kill chain.
briefing:
This is the capstone. NebulaCorp suffered a major breach. Your team has collected five types of evidence from across the environment:

- phishing-email.txt — the initial access phishing email with macro attachment
- netflows.csv — perimeter firewall flow data showing beaconing and exfiltration
- dns-log.txt — edge resolver query log with DNS tunneling evidence
- auth.log — SSH authentication events across multiple hosts
- filesystem-timeline.csv — file system events reconstructed from forensic images

Reconstruct the complete attack kill chain:
1. Initial access (phishing → macro execution)
2. C2 establishment (beacon → external server)
3. Reconnaissance and credential harvesting
4. Lateral movement (workstation → database server)
5. Data staging and exfiltration (database dump → DNS tunnel and HTTPS upload)
6. Cleanup (artifact deletion, history clearing)

Identify the C2 server IP address and the DNS exfiltration domain.

Submit: RANGE{blackout_c2_<c2_ip_with_underscores>_exfil_<exfil_domain_with_underscores>}

For example, if C2 were 10.0.0.1 and exfil went to evil.example: RANGE{blackout_c2_10_0_0_1_exfil_evil_example}
objectives: Identify the initial access vector from the phishing email
Find the C2 beacon pattern in network flows
Identify the exfiltration channel in DNS logs
Correlate the filesystem timeline with network activity

hints.title: C2 beacon
hints.text: In netflows.csv, look for a persistent connection from an internal IP to a single external IP with very regular timing (~60s intervals) and small consistent payload sizes.

hints.title: DNS exfiltration
hints.text: In dns-log.txt, filter for TXT queries with NXDOMAIN responses. The exfiltration domain is the parent domain of those queries (the part after the hex-encoded subdomain).

hints.title: Almost there
hints.text: The C2 IP is 203.0.113.42 (visible in netflows and resolved via c2-relay.nightfall.test in DNS). The DNS exfil goes to data.nebula.test. Format the domain with underscores: data_nebula_test.
